explanation: Noisy sensor (0.02) with coarse dt=0.02 and light cart (0.5) causes controller to saturate at force_limit 30 while cart velocity grows to ~10.9 m/s; pole angular rate diverges to -10.15 rad/s and angle blows past 0.8 rad by step 12. Likely cause is destabilizing feedback under large measurement noise and saturation / delayed discrete control.
